# Rules and gate parameters

<!-- generated by scripts/build.mjs from src/engine/rules.ts and src/engine/gate.ts; do not edit by hand -->

States: NORMAL < ATTENTION < ALARM < TRIP. A signal takes the state of the most severe rule it triggers.

| Rule id | Signal | Kind | Condition | State | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RL-XMEAS9-ATT` | `XMEAS(9)` | ATTENTION_BAND | >= 142.6 degC | ATTENTION | derived from RL-XMEAS9-NU (demo convention, not a published limit) |
| `RL-XMEAS9-NU` | `XMEAS(9)` | NORMAL_UPPER | > 150 degC | ALARM | tags-and-limits/row-2 · frag-05f213cc29 (review-05/06 APPROVE); Downs & Vogel (1993), process operating constraints |
| `RL-XMEAS9-SD` | `XMEAS(9)` | SHUTDOWN_HIGH | >= 175 degC | TRIP | tags-and-limits/row-2 · frag-05f213cc29 (review-05/06 APPROVE); Downs & Vogel (1993), process operating constraints |
| `RL-XMEAS7-ATT` | `XMEAS(7)` | ATTENTION_BAND | >= 2847.5 kPa gauge | ATTENTION | derived from RL-XMEAS7-NU (demo convention, not a published limit) |
| `RL-XMEAS7-NU` | `XMEAS(7)` | NORMAL_UPPER | > 2895 kPa gauge | ALARM | tags-and-limits/row-1 · frag-4999c3a9b6 (review-02/03 APPROVE); Downs & Vogel (1993), process operating constraints |
| `RL-XMEAS7-SD` | `XMEAS(7)` | SHUTDOWN_HIGH | >= 3000 kPa gauge | TRIP | tags-and-limits/row-1 · frag-4999c3a9b6 (review-02/03 APPROVE); Downs & Vogel (1993), process operating constraints |

Every other process signal has **no reviewed limit** and is reported as such, never guessed. `XMEAS(21)` has an explicit reviewed statement that its alarm and shutdown limits are unspecified (`tags-and-limits/row-3 · frag-20b267aeb6`).

Limits left out on purpose: Downs & Vogel (1993) also lists level constraints for the reactor, separator and stripper. They are not in the reviewed knowledge revision, their shutdown values are volumes that need an unsourced conversion to the % measurement, and the lumped model does not simulate levels.

## Gate parameters

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| XMV range | 0–100 % |
| Max step per action | 10 %-points |
| Rate limit | 15 %-points of applied change per XMV per 10 simulated min |
| Simulate-before-act horizon | 30 simulated min (branch copy, same noise as the live plant) |
| Rule check | reject if the branch with the change reaches ALARM or TRIP; if the plant reaches ALARM/TRIP anyway without the change, reject only if the change makes the worst state or any ruled peak worse (so corrective moves stay possible) |
| Headroom check | reject if the peak of a ruled signal rises by more than 5 % of its nominal headroom versus no change (demo convention) |
| SPE check | reject if mean SPE rises by more than 1 x SPE limit versus no change and ends above the limit |
| Rationale | required, max 500 characters |
| Adjustable XMVs | XMV(10) |

Reason codes: XMV_UNKNOWN, XMV_NOT_MODELLED, TARGET_INVALID, TARGET_OUT_OF_RANGE, RATIONALE_MISSING, TRIP_ACTIVE, STEP_TOO_LARGE, RATE_LIMIT, SIM_RULE_TRIP, SIM_RULE_ALARM, SIM_HEADROOM_LOSS, PCA_SPE_WORSENS.
